description: This file is a test script for the 'Student Admission' feature in the Education module, utilizing QUnit to run assertions on the admission form behavior during testing.

methods.name: QUnit.module
methods.description: Defines a test module named 'education' for grouping related tests.

methods.name: QUnit.test
methods.description: Defines a test case to verify the Student Admission form functionality.

methods.name: assert.expect
methods.description: Sets the number of assertions expected in the test.

methods.name: assert.async
methods.description: Creates a callback for asynchronous testing.

methods.name: frappe.run_serially
methods.description: Runs a series of functions sequentially, useful for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: frappe.tests.make
methods.description: Creates a new document of the specified doctype with given data, used here to simulate form filling.

methods.name: cur_frm.save
methods.description: Saves the current form, simulating user submission.
